messages:
kate: heads up — I'm proposing a small schema evolution on telemetry.events to add canonical_route_id (text) and route_origin (enum) to unblock quota routing + console rollups. sketch: dual-write + read-adapter + staged backfill.

samir: high-level sounds good. quick Q: are these new fields nullable during transition? worried about downstream joins if we start returning nulls.

kate: yes nullable initially. plan is: produce fields in a new events_v2 Avro topic, dual-write from ingest for 2 weeks, then backfill historical events into events_v2 for 90 days. read-adapter will synthesize canonical_route_id from existing route_id when missing.

jin: instead of immediate DB backfill, can we rely on adapter enrichment for most queries? full backfill is expensive. adapter could compute on-the-fly and cache.

olivia: console team: on-the-fly is ok for realtime dashboards, but historical rollups (daily p99 by route) need persistent canonical ids to avoid query divergence. backfill needed for rollups and billing.

kate: agreed. backfill scope: 90 days for billing/rollups table; keep event store raw for longer but not backfilled. we'll document which tables are authoritative for each view.

samir: indexing: adding a potentially high-cardinality column worries me. will we index canonical_route_id? index bloat could kill writes.

jin: suggestion: don't add a global index right away. use partitioned materialized views for rollups keyed by canonical_route_id, and add an index on the materialized view only after we validate cardinality in canary.

olivia: for dashboard cutover we need a clear flag in the console: route-id-source = v1|v2|adapter so we can compare panels. also add a small panel showing percent of events with canonical_route_id populated.

kate: yes — feature flag route_attr_v2 for the console. canary plan: 10% tenant traffic -> validate quotas and top-20 route rollups over 48h. metrics to watch: quota deviation, dashboard mismatch rate, ingest latency.

jin: Kafka/schema note: ensure Avro schema is back-compatible (add new fields with default null). downstream consumers will need to handle missing fields. recommend compatibility=FORWARD.

samir: backfill SQL prototype (will need tuning):
```sql
-- backfill canonical_route_id from route_id where missing in events_v2 partitions
UPDATE events_v2
SET canonical_route_id = route_id
WHERE canonical_route_id IS NULL
  AND event_ts >= '2024-01-01'
  AND event_ts < '2024-03-01'
  AND partition = 202401;
```

olivia: also add a read-side test harness: load sample tenant snapshots into a staging console and run nightly diff job comparing v1 vs v2 rollups (route_top20, quota_charge). fail if >0.5% drift.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: infra/canary/route-attr-v2 -> started by kate at 1717890300.

kate: action items: (1) jin - draft adapter + PR for dual-write (2) samir - index/cardinality guardrails and backfill job template (3) olivia - console feature flag + dashboard diff panels + run nightly diff. I'll draft runbook and schedule canary Wed AM.

samir: noted. I'll simulate cardinality using sampled tenant data and share numbers.

jin: I'll add Avro schema and example consumer patch. planning to reuse existing enrichers.

olivia: thanks — will prepare staging dashboards and smoke test checklist.

kate: nice, let's keep this lightweight. drop any concerns or blockers here and I'll fold into the runbook. :thumbsup:
